subject: Follow-up: Audit logs / data access controls (FinCo)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@finco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Audit logs / data access controls (FinCo)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps on the audit/logging questions you raised:

- Primary asks from your side: PII handling (masking/redaction), retention windows for audit logs, who can access logs and how that access is recorded, and export formats (S3/CSV/JSON) for evidence to procurement.
- Our baseline: hosted Redwood API retains audit logs (request metadata + access events) by default for 90 days; Dedicated/Private deployments support configurable retention and customer-managed exports.
- Access controls: RBAC + audit trail for console/API access; every access event is recorded with actor, action, resource, timestamp, and origin IP.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send a short sample audit-log export (CSV) showing schema + sample rows you can pass to procurement.
2) We’ll attach a redacted SOC2 summary and our security one-pager.
3) Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security/infosec folks next week to walk the sample and confirm retention/residency needs?

Would Wednesday 2/25 or Thursday 2/26 at 10am PT work for Samir and your team?

Attaching: redwood_security_onepager.pdf (summary) — will follow with CSV sample and SOC2 redacted.

Best —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@finco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Audit logs / data access controls (FinCo)

Thanks Ben — this is exactly the info we need to start procurement. A few clarifying questions before the follow-up meeting:

1) For the hosted offering (your default): can you confirm the exact audit fields captured for data access (we need at minimum: actor identity, action, resource identifier, timestamp, IP, and request payload hash)?
2) Retention: 90 days baseline is fine for initial evaluation, but procurement will ask about exports for compliance. Can we export the full audit set to a customer S3 (or provide a downloadable CSV/JSON) on demand? Are there limits/rate limits?
3) Residency: we need to understand whether logs and request metadata can be stored in the EU region for our EU-backed subsidiary. Is that available on hosted or only via Dedicated/Private?
4) Evidence: procurement will ask for an example export and wording we can include in the contract that specifies "who accessed what and when". Can you provide a sample CSV and an excerpt of the log schema we can attach to the contract?

If you can get a sample export and SOC2 redacted doc to me by EOD tomorrow that would be ideal. 2/25 at 10am PT works for Samir and myself.

-Alice
Alice Tan
Head of IT Risk, FinCo
alice.tan@finco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@finco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Audit logs / data access controls (FinCo)

Alice — thanks for the detailed questions. Looping in Laura (solutions engineering) and Marissa (CS) — they'll provide the sample export and the SOC2 redacted summary. Quick answers to your questions below, then Laura will follow with the CSV/sample: 

1) Audit fields: yes — hosted logs include: actor_id, actor_type (user/service), action (read/write/export), target_resource (model/api route/request_id), timestamp (RFC3339), origin_ip, user_agent, request_payload_hash, response_size, and the policy_verification_result (allow/deny). We can include additional metadata upon request.

2) Exports: Hosted customers can request on-demand exports (CSV/JSON) of the audit dataset. We also support scheduled exports to a customer S3 for Dedicated/Private. For hosted, exports are delivered via secure, time-limited S3 presigned URLs; rate limits are primarily for very large exports (>50GB) but for audit CSVs (up to 30 days) there are no additional charges.

3) Residency: EU-region data residency for logs is supported for Hosted in our EU region (requires account configuration) and is standard for Dedicated/Private. We'll confirm the exact EU storage location and controls in the follow-up.

4) Evidence: Laura will attach a sample CSV and a short log schema snippet you can drop into the contract. If procurement needs custom export fields or longer retention, we can add that as a contract-controlled feature (extra retention) — we’ll propose language.

Laura/Marissa: can you attach the sample and SOC2 redacted and confirm whether the hosted export delivery mechanism (presigned S3 link) and the default 90-day retention meet FinCo's initial reqs?

Thanks —
Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@finco.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Sample: Audit log export + schema (FinCo)

Hi Alice / Ben — attaching a redacted sample export and SOC2 summary as requested. See notes and schema below.

Attachments: finco_audit_logs_sample.csv (redacted), SOC2_redacted.pdf

Sample schema (CSV columns):
- timestamp (RFC3339)
- request_id
- actor_id
- actor_type
- action
- target_resource
- origin_ip
- user_agent
- request_payload_hash
- response_size_bytes
- policy_verification_result
- access_granted_by (if applicable)

Sample row (CSV):
2026-02-17T15:21:03Z, req_0a1b2c3d, user_finco_alice, user, read, api/v1/generate?model=redwood-13b, 18.232.4.12, python-requests/2.28, 3f5a8..., 1423, allow, admin_service

Notes / clarifications:
- Retention: Hosted default = 90 days. We can configure longer retention (365 days or custom) for Dedicated/Private or as a contract add-on. For very long retention requirements we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments where data location and retention are fully customer-configurable.
- Exports: Hosted export process — we generate a filtered export, upload to a presigned S3 URL you control for download; exports can also be produced as JSON/CSV. For Dedicated/Private we can write directly to your S3 bucket.
- Access controls: RBAC enforced at the org/account level. Console/API role actions are logged; every access event includes the actor identifier, timestamp, action, and origin IP. Audit exports include the access_granted_by field when an automated policy or admin approved access.
- Residency: We support region-specific storage for logs. For EU-only storage, we can enable tenancy in our eu-west-1 region for Hosted accounts or deploy Dedicated/Private in your preferred region.
- Evidence: The attached CSV and SOC2_redacted.pdf are appropriate to include as procurement evidence. We can provide a short contract clause stating: "Provider will record and provide, upon Customer request, audit evidence showing actor identity, action, target resource, and timestamp for accesses to Customer data." We can work with your legal to finalize language.

Next steps:
- Ben: confirm 2/25 10am PT for a 30-min walk-through (we’ll invite a solutions engineer to demo the export flow).
- Alice/Samir: review the sample CSV and let us know if you need additional fields or longer retention in the contract.
- If procurement needs formatted contract language, Marissa can draft the clause and Ben will share with your counsel.

Cheers —
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
